entries.name: Users
entries.purpose: People reaching the system over the internet from browsers or apps.

entries.name: Mobile app
entries.purpose: Native iOS or Android app calling the backend over the internet.

entries.name: IoT devices
entries.purpose: Sensors, gateways and machines sending telemetry from the field.

entries.name: On-premises data center
entries.purpose: Your own data center or colocation site running existing systems.

entries.name: Branch office
entries.purpose: Remote office or store network that needs private access to cloud resources.

entries.name: Third-party service
entries.purpose: External SaaS or API outside Alibaba Cloud, such as payments or email.

entries.name: Alibaba Cloud DNS
entries.purpose: Authoritative public DNS for your domains; a resolve hop, not on the data path.
entries.useWhen: Any public domain; pair with ESA or GTM for traffic steering.
entries.avoidWhen: Never draw it inline; users resolve names, then connect to the first edge service.

entries.name: Global Traffic Manager (GTM)
entries.purpose: DNS-based traffic steering with health checks and failover across regions.
entries.useWhen: Active-active or failover setups across regions or clouds.
entries.avoidWhen: Single-region apps; plain DNS is enough.
entries.note: Design with GTM 3.0; the legacy version stopped sales 2026-06-30 and ends service 2026-12-31.

entries.name: HTTPDNS
entries.purpose: DNS-over-HTTPS SDK for apps that prevents hijacking and improves scheduling.
entries.useWhen: Mobile apps that suffer DNS hijacking or need precise routing.

entries.name: Domain Names
entries.purpose: Register, renew and transfer domain names.

entries.name: Edge Security Acceleration (ESA)
entries.purpose: Global edge: caching, dynamic acceleration, WAF, DDoS defense, bot management and edge functions.
entries.useWhen: Public sites and APIs needing acceleration plus edge security in one service.
entries.avoidWhen: Purely static assets on a tight budget; plain CDN is simpler.
entries.note: Includes its own WAF and DDoS protection; add standalone WAF only for deeper rule sets.

entries.name: CDN
entries.purpose: Caches static content on edge nodes close to users.
entries.useWhen: Static files, images and downloads served worldwide.
entries.avoidWhen: Dynamic APIs or when edge security is also needed; prefer ESA.

entries.name: Global Accelerator (GA)
entries.purpose: Anycast entry points carrying traffic over the Alibaba backbone to regional endpoints.
entries.useWhen: Users far from the region; TCP/UDP or HTTP apps needing steady cross-border latency.

entries.name: Anycast Elastic IP Address
entries.purpose: One global anycast IP that takes in traffic at the nearest point of presence.
entries.useWhen: Inbound traffic to backends in a few overseas regions through one IP.
entries.avoidWhen: Chinese mainland users; it has no mainland access points.
entries.note: Inbound only; backends in Hong Kong, Singapore, Tokyo, Frankfurt or US regions.

entries.name: Anti-DDoS Pro/Premium (Anti-DDoS Proxy)
entries.purpose: Proxy scrubbing of large L3-L7 DDoS attacks via CNAME or IP; Premium for overseas origins.
entries.useWhen: Frequent targets of volumetric attacks: games, finance, flash-sale e-commerce.
entries.avoidWhen: ESA already fronts the site and its DDoS protection is enough.

entries.name: Web Application Firewall (WAF)
entries.purpose: WAF 3.0: blocks OWASP attacks, CC floods and bots via cloud-native or CNAME access.
entries.useWhen: Public web apps and APIs; usually a badge on ALB, the API gateway or FC.
entries.avoidWhen: ESA built-in WAF rules already cover the need.
entries.note: Cloud-native mode attaches to ALB, API gateway or FC without DNS changes; draw it inline only in CNAME mode.

entries.name: Edge Node Service (ENS)
entries.purpose: Compute instances on distributed edge nodes close to end users.
entries.useWhen: Latency-critical workloads such as cloud gaming, live streaming or edge inference.

entries.name: Virtual Private Cloud (VPC)
entries.purpose: Isolated private network with per-zone vSwitches; drawn as the container, not a node.
entries.useWhen: Every design with ECS, ACK, databases or load balancers.
entries.note: Render as a group (region > VPC > zone vSwitch), never as a box on the request path.

entries.name: Application Load Balancer (ALB)
entries.purpose: Layer-7 HTTP/HTTPS/gRPC load balancer with content routing; also serves as ACK Ingress.
entries.useWhen: Web apps and APIs needing host or path routing across zones.
entries.avoidWhen: Raw TCP/UDP at very high connection counts; use NLB.

entries.name: Network Load Balancer (NLB)
entries.purpose: Layer-4 load balancer for TCP, UDP and TCPSSL traffic at very high connection counts.
entries.useWhen: Games, IoT, MQTT and other long-lived TCP or UDP traffic.
entries.avoidWhen: HTTP routing needs; use ALB.

entries.name: Classic Load Balancer (CLB)
entries.purpose: Original layer-4/7 load balancer, formerly called SLB.
entries.useWhen: Existing deployments that already run on CLB.
entries.avoidWhen: New designs; prefer ALB for HTTP or NLB for TCP/UDP.
entries.note: 'SLB' now names the whole family (ALB, NLB, GWLB, CLB); pay-by-spec CLB sales ended 2026-01-01; prefer ALB or NLB.

entries.name: Gateway Load Balancer (GWLB)
entries.purpose: Transparently steers traffic through third-party firewall or inspection appliances.
entries.useWhen: Inline third-party security appliances such as NGFW or IDS in a security VPC.

entries.name: Elastic IP Address (EIP)
entries.purpose: Standalone public IP address bound to ECS, NAT gateways or load balancers.
entries.useWhen: Any resource that needs a stable public address.

entries.name: NAT Gateway
entries.purpose: Gives private VPC resources outbound internet (SNAT) and mapped inbound ports (DNAT).
entries.useWhen: Private ECS or ACK nodes that call external APIs or fetch updates.

entries.name: IPv6 Gateway
entries.purpose: Controls IPv6 internet access for a VPC, including egress-only rules.
entries.useWhen: Dual-stack apps that must serve or reach IPv6 clients.

entries.name: PrivateLink
entries.purpose: Private endpoints to Alibaba Cloud or partner services without internet exposure.
entries.useWhen: Reaching managed or partner services privately from a VPC.

entries.name: Alibaba Cloud DNS PrivateZone
entries.purpose: Private DNS zones inside VPCs, with hybrid DNS forwarding.
entries.useWhen: Internal service names and hybrid DNS between on-premises and VPCs.

entries.name: Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN)
entries.purpose: Global private network linking VPCs and hybrid links across regions and accounts.
entries.useWhen: Multi-region, multi-account or hybrid networks that need private routing.
entries.avoidWhen: A single VPC with nothing to connect.

entries.name: Transit Router (TR)
entries.purpose: Regional hub router in CEN for VPC, VBR and VPN attachments.
entries.useWhen: Hub-and-spoke routing between many VPCs or hybrid links in one region.

entries.name: Express Connect
entries.purpose: Dedicated physical lines from your data center into VPCs through virtual border routers.
entries.useWhen: Stable, high-bandwidth hybrid links to on-premises data centers.
entries.avoidWhen: Small branches or quick setups; VPN Gateway is cheaper and faster to set up.

entries.name: VPN Gateway
entries.purpose: Encrypted site-to-site (IPsec) and client (SSL) VPN tunnels into a VPC.
entries.useWhen: Quick encrypted links from offices or data centers over the internet.
entries.avoidWhen: Large steady hybrid traffic; prefer Express Connect.

entries.name: Smart Access Gateway (SAG)
entries.purpose: SD-WAN appliances and client app connecting branches to VPCs or CEN.
entries.useWhen: Existing SAG branch networks.
entries.avoidWhen: New designs; prefer VPN Gateway or Express Connect.
entries.note: Older product with no end-of-sale notice found; avoid in new designs.

entries.name: Edge Network Acceleration (ENA)
entries.purpose: Managed layer-2 links that replace leased lines between branches, data centers and cloud.
entries.useWhen: Replacing costly leased lines between sites.

entries.name: Network Intelligence Service (NIS)
entries.purpose: Network topology, traffic analysis and connectivity diagnostics.
entries.useWhen: Troubleshooting reachability or traffic hot spots across VPCs.

entries.name: Elastic Compute Service (ECS)
entries.purpose: Virtual machines (x86, Arm, GPU) with cloud disks and security groups.
entries.useWhen: Full OS control, lift-and-shift apps or steady workloads.
entries.avoidWhen: Spiky or event-driven loads with nothing to manage; consider SAE or FC.

entries.name: Elastic GPU Service (EGS)
entries.purpose: GPU-accelerated ECS instance families for training, inference and rendering.
entries.useWhen: Inference, rendering or small training jobs that need dedicated GPUs.
entries.note: These are ECS GPU instance families; draw as an ECS node with a GPU marker.

entries.name: ECS Bare Metal Instance
entries.purpose: Bare-metal servers with ECS elasticity, for no-virtualization or licensing needs.

entries.name: Simple Application Server (SAS)
entries.purpose: All-in-one lightweight server with disk and bandwidth, sold as monthly plans.
entries.useWhen: Small websites, blogs or test environments on a fixed budget.
entries.avoidWhen: Production apps that need VPC networking or scaling; use ECS.
entries.note: Runs in its own managed network, not your VPC. 'SAS' is also Security Center's API code; use the id swas.

entries.name: Dedicated Host (DDH)
entries.purpose: Single-tenant physical host for placing ECS instances, for BYOL or compliance.

entries.name: Auto Scaling (ESS)
entries.purpose: Scales ECS or ECI fleets by rules, schedules or metrics and registers them to load balancers.
entries.useWhen: Traffic spikes such as flash sales on ECS fleets.
entries.note: Free; draw as a scaling-group frame on the ECS node, not as a box on the path.

entries.name: Elastic High Performance Computing (E-HPC)
entries.purpose: Managed HPC clusters with Slurm, PBS or LSF on ECS and GPU instances.
entries.useWhen: Simulation, genomics or rendering batch jobs.

entries.name: Function Compute (FC)
entries.purpose: Event-driven serverless functions and web functions, including GPU model serving.
entries.useWhen: Event or HTTP workloads with bursty traffic and no servers to manage.
entries.avoidWhen: Long-running stateful services; use SAE, ACK or ECS.
entries.note: Design on FC 3.0 (FC 2.0 is legacy). Drawn outside the VPC unless VPC access is configured.

entries.name: Serverless App Engine (SAE)
entries.purpose: Serverless PaaS for containers and Java apps, without servers or Kubernetes to run.
entries.useWhen: Microservices or web apps when the team wants to avoid Kubernetes.
entries.avoidWhen: Teams that need full Kubernetes APIs; use ACK.

entries.name: Compute Nest
entries.purpose: Platform for vendors to publish, deploy and operate software in customer accounts.
entries.useWhen: ISVs delivering managed software into customer accounts.
entries.avoidWhen: Not a runtime component of an application.

entries.name: CloudBox
entries.purpose: Alibaba Cloud ECS, OSS and CLB hardware installed in your own data center.
entries.useWhen: Data-residency or latency needs that require cloud services on premises.

entries.name: Alibaba Cloud Linux
entries.purpose: ECS-optimized Linux operating system; an attribute of ECS, not a separate node.
entries.note: Alinux 2 reached end of life; ANOLISA was renamed Agentic OS on 2026-09-10.

entries.name: Container Service for Kubernetes (ACK)
entries.purpose: Managed Kubernetes (ACK Pro) with node pools, CSI storage, Ingress and an AI suite.
entries.useWhen: Teams standardizing on Kubernetes or running many microservices.
entries.avoidWhen: Small teams avoiding Kubernetes; consider SAE or ACS.
entries.note: No new ACK Edge clusters from 2026-09-03; new serverless clusters go to ACS.

entries.name: Container Compute Service (ACS)
entries.purpose: Serverless Kubernetes: pay-per-pod CPU and GPU compute, Agent Sandbox and Knative.
entries.useWhen: Kubernetes workloads without node management, or bursty jobs.
entries.note: Recommended successor for ACK Serverless clusters.

entries.name: Elastic Container Instance (ECI)
entries.purpose: Runs containers without managing nodes; also adds burst capacity to ACK clusters.
entries.useWhen: Burst or batch containers, or virtual nodes for ACK.

entries.name: Container Registry (ACR)
entries.purpose: Private registry for container images, Helm charts and OCI artifacts with scanning and signing.
entries.useWhen: Any ACK, ACS, SAE or ECI deployment pipeline.

entries.name: Alibaba Cloud Service Mesh (ASM)
entries.purpose: Managed Istio control plane for mTLS and traffic management across clusters.
entries.useWhen: Many microservices needing mTLS, canary routing or multi-cluster traffic.
entries.avoidWhen: A handful of services; MSE or an API gateway is simpler.

entries.name: Distributed Cloud Container Platform for Kubernetes (ACK One)
aliases: Distributed Cloud Container Platform for Kubernetes
entries.purpose: Multi-cluster and hybrid Kubernetes fleet management with GitOps (Argo CD).
entries.useWhen: Fleets of clusters across regions, clouds or on-premises.

entries.name: Elastic Block Storage (EBS)
entries.purpose: Cloud disks (ESSD, ESSD AutoPL) and snapshots for ECS; an attachment, not a node.

entries.name: Object Storage Service (OSS)
entries.purpose: Durable object storage for files, media, backups and data lakes; S3-compatible.
entries.useWhen: Images, uploads, static sites, backups and lakehouse data.
entries.avoidWhen: Low-latency shared POSIX file access; use NAS.
entries.note: Regional service drawn outside the VPC; reach it through its internal endpoint.

entries.name: File Storage NAS
entries.purpose: Managed NFS/SMB shared file system mounted by ECS, ACK or FC.
entries.useWhen: Shared files across instances or pods, such as CMS uploads.
entries.avoidWhen: Massive object data or static web assets; use OSS.

entries.name: Cloud Parallel File Storage (CPFS)
entries.purpose: Parallel file system with very high throughput for HPC and AI training data.
entries.useWhen: GPU training clusters or HPC that need very high throughput.

entries.name: Tablestore
entries.purpose: Serverless NoSQL for wide-column, time-series and agent-memory data at massive scale.
entries.useWhen: Huge key-value, IoT time series or AI agent memory with serverless pricing.
entries.avoidWhen: Relational queries and joins; use RDS or PolarDB.

entries.name: Cloud Backup
entries.purpose: Backup and disaster recovery for ECS, databases, NAS, OSS and VMware.
entries.useWhen: Point-in-time recovery and cross-region DR for ECS and file data.

entries.name: Intelligent Media Management (IMM)
entries.purpose: Document conversion and preview plus image and video AI analysis on OSS data.

entries.name: Data Online Migration
entries.purpose: Copies data online into OSS from S3, NAS, HDFS or other clouds.
entries.useWhen: Moving existing object or file data into OSS.

entries.name: Data Transport
entries.purpose: Offline appliance shipping to move terabytes to petabytes of data into OSS.

entries.name: Cloud Storage Gateway (CSG)
entries.purpose: NFS, SMB or iSCSI gateway that caches on-premises data and stores it in OSS.
entries.useWhen: Hybrid file shares or backup targets backed by OSS.

entries.name: PolarDB
entries.purpose: Cloud-native relational database (MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle-compatible) with compute-storage separation.
entries.useWhen: High-concurrency OLTP needing fast read scale-out and quick failover.
entries.avoidWhen: Small, low-cost databases; RDS is simpler.
entries.note: PolarDB-X is the distributed edition (formerly DRDS).

entries.name: ApsaraDB RDS
entries.purpose: Managed MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server and MariaDB with HA, read replicas and backups.
entries.useWhen: Standard relational workloads on familiar engines.
entries.avoidWhen: Very high write scale or instant read scale-out; consider PolarDB.

entries.name: Tair (Redis® OSS-Compatible)
entries.purpose: Managed Redis-compatible in-memory database and cache, plus Tair enterprise features.
entries.useWhen: Sessions, hot reads, leaderboards, queues and rate limiting.
entries.avoidWhen: Primary system of record for durable data.
entries.note: Formerly ApsaraDB for Redis (merged into the Tair brand on 2024-09-27).

entries.name: ApsaraDB for MongoDB
entries.purpose: Fully managed MongoDB as replica sets or sharded clusters.
entries.useWhen: Document data with flexible schemas.

entries.name: Lindorm
entries.purpose: Multi-model database: HBase-compatible wide column, time series, search and vector.
entries.useWhen: New HBase, Cassandra or time-series style workloads at scale.

entries.name: ApsaraDB for HBase
entries.purpose: Managed Apache HBase wide-column database.
entries.useWhen: Existing HBase applications.
entries.avoidWhen: New designs; prefer Lindorm.
entries.note: Still listed, but Lindorm is the recommended choice for new wide-column workloads.

entries.name: AnalyticDB
entries.purpose: Real-time data warehouse with MySQL-compatible lakehouse and PostgreSQL (vector) engines.
entries.useWhen: Interactive analytics on large datasets, or PostgreSQL vector search for RAG.

entries.name: ApsaraDB for ClickHouse
entries.purpose: Managed ClickHouse for real-time OLAP queries.
entries.useWhen: Log, event or clickstream analytics with sub-second queries.

entries.name: ApsaraDB for SelectDB
entries.purpose: Managed Apache Doris real-time analytical warehouse.

entries.name: Data Transmission Service (DTS)
entries.purpose: Database migration, real-time synchronization and change data capture.
entries.useWhen: Migrating databases or syncing them across regions or into warehouses.

entries.name: Data Management (DMS)
entries.purpose: Database DevOps: SQL review, change workflows, data agents and backup.

entries.name: Database Autonomy Service (DAS)
entries.purpose: Autonomous diagnosis, tuning and anomaly detection for Alibaba Cloud databases.

entries.name: MaxCompute
entries.purpose: Serverless exabyte-scale data warehouse for batch SQL and Spark.
entries.useWhen: Large batch ETL and offline analytics.
entries.avoidWhen: Sub-second interactive queries; use Hologres.

entries.name: Hologres
entries.purpose: Real-time PostgreSQL-compatible warehouse for interactive analytics and online serving.
entries.useWhen: Real-time dashboards and analytics served to applications.

entries.name: Realtime Compute for Apache Flink
entries.purpose: Managed Apache Flink for SQL stream processing and CDC pipelines.
entries.useWhen: Streaming ETL, real-time metrics or CDC into warehouses.

entries.name: E-MapReduce (EMR)
entries.purpose: Managed Hadoop, Spark and StarRocks clusters, plus serverless Spark and StarRocks.
entries.useWhen: Open-source big-data engines with full control.

entries.name: Data Lake Formation (DLF)
entries.purpose: Paimon-based lakehouse catalog and permissions over data in OSS.

entries.name: DataWorks
entries.purpose: Data integration, development, scheduling and governance, with a built-in data agent.

entries.name: DataHub
entries.purpose: Real-time data streaming and distribution through publish-subscribe topics.

entries.name: Elasticsearch
entries.purpose: Managed Elasticsearch for full-text, log and vector or hybrid AI search.
entries.useWhen: Product search, log analytics or hybrid keyword and vector RAG.

entries.name: Vector Retrieval Service for Milvus
entries.purpose: Managed vector database compatible with open-source Milvus, for RAG and multimodal search.
entries.useWhen: The default vector store for international RAG designs.

entries.name: DataV
entries.purpose: Low-code dashboards and large-screen data visualization.

entries.name: Quick BI
entries.purpose: BI dashboards and reports with natural-language questions (Smart Q).
entries.useWhen: Self-service BI for business users over warehouses and databases.

entries.name: Microservices Engine (MSE)
entries.purpose: Managed Nacos or ZooKeeper registry and config, plus microservice governance.
entries.useWhen: Spring Cloud or Dubbo microservices needing registry, config and traffic governance.
entries.note: Its cloud-native gateway stopped new purchases on 2026-08-23; use Cloud-native API Gateway for ingress.

entries.name: Cloud-native API Gateway
entries.purpose: Managed Envoy/Higress gateway for REST, HTTP and WebSocket APIs with auth and throttling.
entries.useWhen: Public APIs, microservice ingress, API keys and rate limits.
entries.avoidWhen: Simple web apps where ALB routing is enough.
entries.note: Successor of API Gateway (Classic) and the MSE cloud-native gateway, which stopped new purchases on 2026-08-23.

entries.name: AI Gateway
entries.purpose: LLM, MCP and agent gateway: multi-model routing, fallback, token limits, caching and guardrails.
entries.useWhen: Apps calling several models or MCP servers that need quotas and failover.
entries.note: Sits between the app and its models; part of the API Gateway family.
intents: one gateway for LLMs, MCP servers and agents

entries.name: ApsaraMQ for RocketMQ
entries.purpose: Managed RocketMQ 5.x for transactional, scheduled and ordered messaging.
entries.useWhen: Order flows, flash-sale queues and event-driven microservices.

entries.name: ApsaraMQ for Kafka
entries.purpose: Managed Apache Kafka (standard, professional, serverless) for streaming pipelines.
entries.useWhen: Log and event streaming into Flink, warehouses or search.

entries.name: ApsaraMQ for RabbitMQ
entries.purpose: Fully managed RabbitMQ broker speaking AMQP 0-9-1.

entries.name: ApsaraMQ for MQTT
entries.purpose: MQTT and WebSocket broker for large fleets of IoT and mobile clients.
entries.useWhen: Device telemetry or push messaging to apps.

entries.name: ApsaraMQ for Confluent
entries.purpose: Fully managed Confluent Platform with Kafka, connectors and schema registry.

entries.name: Simple Message Queue (SMQ)
entries.purpose: Serverless queues and pub/sub topics for decoupling services.

entries.name: EventBridge
entries.purpose: Serverless event bus that routes CloudEvents from sources to targets by rules.

entries.name: CloudFlow
entries.purpose: Serverless state-machine workflows that orchestrate functions and services.

entries.name: SchedulerX
entries.purpose: Distributed cron and DAG job scheduling, including managed XXL-JOB.

entries.name: Enterprise Distributed Application Service (EDAS)
entries.purpose: PaaS for Java microservices (Spring Cloud, Dubbo, HSF) on ECS or ACK.
entries.useWhen: Existing HSF or Dubbo estates that need managed deployment.
entries.avoidWhen: New builds; SAE plus MSE is the lighter path.

entries.name: Application Real-Time Monitoring Service (ARMS)
entries.purpose: APM, browser and synthetic monitoring, tracing and alerting for applications.
entries.note: ARMS Basic Edition was discontinued on 2026-10-15.

entries.name: Managed Service for Prometheus
entries.purpose: Managed Prometheus metrics for ACK, ECS and applications.

entries.name: Managed Service for Grafana
entries.purpose: Managed Grafana dashboards over Prometheus, SLS, CloudMonitor and ARMS.

entries.name: Managed Service for OpenTelemetry
entries.purpose: Managed distributed tracing compatible with OpenTelemetry and Jaeger.

entries.name: Performance Testing Service (PTS)
entries.purpose: Cloud load testing compatible with JMeter scripts.

entries.name: Anti-DDoS Native
entries.purpose: In-region DDoS scrubbing for public IPs of ECS, NAT and load balancers, with no IP change.
entries.useWhen: Baseline protection beyond the free tier for public IPs.
entries.note: Native 2.0 pay-as-you-go stopped new purchases on 2026-06-20; use the subscription.

entries.name: Cloud Firewall
entries.purpose: Internet, VPC and NAT border firewalls with intrusion prevention and access control.
entries.useWhen: Central egress and east-west control across VPCs.

entries.name: Security Center
entries.purpose: Workload protection: vulnerabilities, baselines, threat detection and Agentic SOC (SIEM/SOAR).
entries.useWhen: Any production account running ECS or containers.
entries.note: Agents run on hosts, but draw it in the governance band, never inside the VPC. Its API code is 'sas'.

entries.name: Bastionhost
entries.purpose: Privileged access gateway with MFA and session audit for server and database operations.
entries.useWhen: Controlled admin access for operators and vendors.

entries.name: Key Management Service (KMS)
entries.purpose: Managed encryption keys with rotation and BYOK, plus Secrets Manager.

entries.name: Cloud Hardware Security Module (HSM)
entries.purpose: FIPS 140-3 hardware security modules for keys you must hold yourself.

entries.name: Certificate Management Service
entries.purpose: Buy, issue and deploy SSL/TLS certificates, including a private CA.

entries.name: Data Security Center (DSC)
entries.purpose: Finds, classifies and audits sensitive data in RDS, OSS, MaxCompute and more.

entries.name: Secure Access Service Edge (SASE)
entries.purpose: Zero-trust office access: ZTNA, secure web gateway, CASB and DLP for staff.
entries.useWhen: Remote staff reaching internal apps without a VPN.

entries.name: Identity as a Service (IDaaS)
entries.purpose: Workforce and customer identity with SSO, MFA and user directories.
entries.useWhen: Single sign-on for staff apps or login for customer apps.

entries.name: Resource Access Management (RAM)
entries.purpose: Users, roles, policies and STS tokens that control access to Alibaba Cloud.
entries.note: Governance band only; never draw it inside a VPC.

entries.name: ID Verification
entries.purpose: eKYC with document OCR, liveness detection and face comparison for onboarding.

entries.name: Captcha
entries.purpose: Bot challenge (CAPTCHA 2.0) protecting login, sign-up and SMS flows.

entries.name: Content Moderation
entries.purpose: Moderates text, images, audio and video in user-generated content.
entries.note: Documented as the moderation layer of AI Guardrails; still sold separately.

entries.name: Fraud Detection
entries.purpose: Risk scoring against fake sign-ups, account takeover and promotion abuse.

entries.name: Managed Security Service (MSS)
entries.purpose: Security experts who monitor, detect and respond to threats on your workloads.
entries.avoidWhen: It is a service engagement, not a diagram component.

entries.name: Simple Log Service (SLS)
entries.purpose: Collects, searches, analyzes with SQL and alerts on logs, metrics and traces.
entries.note: Regional service drawn outside the VPC.

entries.name: CloudMonitor
entries.purpose: Resource metrics, alarms and site monitoring; CMS 2.0 adds APM and AI observability.

entries.name: CloudOps Orchestration Service (OOS)
entries.purpose: Runs O&M automation: runbooks, patch baselines and scheduled operations.

entries.name: ActionTrail
entries.purpose: Audit trail of console and API actions, delivered to SLS or OSS.

entries.name: Cloud Config
entries.purpose: Tracks resource configuration changes and evaluates compliance rules.

entries.name: Resource Management
entries.purpose: Resource Directory for multi-account setups, plus resource groups, tags and sharing.

entries.name: CloudSSO
entries.purpose: SAML single sign-on and SCIM provisioning across Resource Directory accounts.

entries.name: Agentic Cloud Governance Center (ACGC)
entries.purpose: Sets up and governs multi-account landing zones for cloud and AI workloads.
entries.note: Renamed from Cloud Governance Center on 2026-06-24.

entries.name: Intelligent Advisor
entries.purpose: Well-Architected risk checks across security, cost, stability and quotas.

entries.name: Cloud Architect Design Tools (CADT)
entries.purpose: Visual architecture design and deployment tool with an AI assistant.
entries.avoidWhen: Not a runtime component; it is a design tool.

entries.name: Server Migration Center (SMC)
entries.purpose: Migrates physical servers, VMs and other-cloud servers to ECS.

entries.name: Cloud Migration Hub (CMH)
entries.purpose: Discovery, planning and assessment for migrating workloads to Alibaba Cloud.

entries.name: Service Catalog
entries.purpose: Governed self-service provisioning of approved infrastructure-as-code products.

entries.name: OpenAPI Portal
entries.purpose: API reference, debugging, SDKs, CLI and an MCP server for Alibaba Cloud APIs.

entries.name: Alibaba Cloud CLI
entries.purpose: The aliyun command-line tool for managing cloud resources.

entries.name: Cloud Shell
entries.purpose: Browser shell with the CLI, Terraform and kubectl preinstalled.

entries.name: Resource Orchestration Service (ROS)
entries.purpose: Infrastructure-as-code templates and stacks, including hosted Terraform.

entries.name: Terraform (alicloud provider)
entries.purpose: HashiCorp Terraform provider for defining Alibaba Cloud infrastructure as code.
entries.note: Provider v2.1.0 was released on 2026-10-22.

entries.name: Alibaba Cloud DevOps
entries.purpose: Git repositories, CI/CD pipelines, artifact repositories and project management.
entries.note: Its OpenAPI endpoint is cn-hangzhou only; confirm availability for international accounts.

entries.name: Alibaba Cloud Marketplace
entries.purpose: Third-party software, SaaS and images with BYOL, pay-as-you-go or private offers.
entries.avoidWhen: It is a procurement channel, not a diagram node.

entries.name: ICP Filing
entries.purpose: Mandatory filing for websites served from Chinese mainland regions.
entries.avoidWhen: International accounts cannot file; a China-site account is required.
entries.note: Needed only for servers in the Chinese mainland; the filing system is in Chinese only.

entries.name: GoChina ICP Filing Assistant
entries.purpose: Paid help for companies outside the mainland to obtain ICP filing.

entries.name: Apsara Stack
entries.purpose: Alibaba Cloud services deployed in your own data center as a private or hybrid cloud.

entries.name: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio
entries.purpose: Managed model APIs for Qwen (such as qwen3.8-max) and third-party models; OpenAI-compatible.
entries.useWhen: Apps that call LLMs, embeddings or realtime voice models by API.
entries.avoidWhen: Coding-tool subscriptions; use Coding Plan or Token Plan. Self-hosted weights; use PAI.
entries.note: Keys and model lists are per region. Agent apps and knowledge base are closed to new international accounts (see model-studio-apps).
